  Filled in by the /pr skill, or by hand. Delete these comments as you go.
  Every section is required. If a section would be empty, that is a signal the
  branch is not ready, not a license to drop the heading.
-->

## Summary

<!--
  Two or three sentences in plain language: what this changes, for whom.
  Write it from the full diff, not from the commit messages.
-->

## Commits

<!-- One bullet per commit title, oldest first, verbatim. -->

## Key files

<!--
  At most three, ranked by how much a reviewer needs to understand them — not by
  line count. A one-line config change that alters behaviour outranks a large
  test file. Give each one a short clause saying why it matters. Never list
  lockfiles or generated output here.
-->

## Rationale

<!--
  What this is trying to accomplish and why this approach over the alternatives.
  Name anything you want the reviewer to push back on, and any decision you made
  that the ticket did not settle.
-->
